subject: Evaluation kickoff & technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rivera <elena@cleverhealth.ai>, Tom Hughes <tom@cleverhealth.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation kickoff & technical deep dive

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — great to hear more about CleverHealth's plans to add LLM-powered clinical summarization to the CareOps workflow. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a trial kicked off: 

Summary from today
- Key use case: extractive + abstractive summaries of care notes for care coordinators (target latency < 300ms median).
- Target docs: de-identified clinical notes, ~300-1,200 tokens typical.
- Success criteria: (1) 85%+ factual accuracy on the evaluation prompt set, (2) median p99 latency under 400ms in your staging environment, (3) cost target ~ $X per 1k tokens.

Proposed evaluation kickoff (what we need to do)
1) Technical deep dive with our SE (Dylan) to align on infra, data ingestion, and access (30–45m).
2) Trial plan: 2-week evaluation on Redwood Dedicated or Private (your choice), we'll provision a test endpoint and share an evaluation prompt set.
3) Provide sample prompt set + evaluation rubric (attached).
4) Security & compliance: we'll need a completed security questionnaire and a brief SOW/LOE for provisioning.

Suggested slots for the SE deep dive (all PT):
- Tue, 16 Mar — 10:00–11:00
- Wed, 17 Mar — 14:00–15:00 (preferred)
- Thu, 18 Mar — 09:00–10:00

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side should join (engineering, infra, and security)? I’m attaching a draft trial_plan_v1.pdf and a sample_prompt_set.xlsx to help you review before the kickoff.

Also flagging two items on our side you should expect:
- We'll ask for a small test dataset (de-identified) and an allowlist IP range or VPN access for Private deployments.
- If you want us to run a SOC2/security review before provisioning, let me know and I’ll route the questionnaire.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

- Success criteria: we’d like to tweak the accuracy threshold to 80% F1 on our clinical extraction prompts (we can share the tolerance rubric). Latency target looks reasonable — happy to iterate.
- Team: I’ll join, Tom (CTO) will join for the kickoff, and Priya (Lead ML Engineer) should be on the technical deep dive.

For availability, Wed, 17 Mar 14:00–15:00 PT works best for all of us. Could you confirm and send a calendar invite?

Also: we prefer Redwood to run the trial on Dedicated capacity while we evaluate; we’ll confirm environment details in the kickoff. We’ll also pull together a small de-identified sample dataset by Monday the 15th.

Thanks — Elena
